TEXT.source: NTU Corpus stories for Sakizaya, story: skzyNr-hunting_kaniw
TEXT.citation: Sung, L. M., Lily, I., Hsieh, F., & Lin, Z. (2008). Developing an online corpus of Formosan languages. Taiwan Journal of Linguistics, 6(2.).
TEXT.BibTeX_citation: @article{sung2008developing,title={Developing an online corpus of Formosan languages.},author={Sung, Li-May and Lily, I and Hsieh, Fuhui and Lin, Zhemin and others},journal={Taiwan Journal of Linguistics},volume={6},number={2},year={2008}}

S.FORM: sumamad u nikauzip haw nu Sakizaya cay kauyza a dada haw canacanan haw ku nika pilungucan.
S.PHON: sumamad u nikauzip ħaw nu sakizaja ʦaj kaujza a dada ħaw ʦanaʦanan ħaw ku nika pi[r|ɾ]uŋuʦan
S.FORM: sumamad u nikauzip haw nu Sakizaya cay kauyza a dada haw canacanan haw ku nika pilungucan.
S.PHON: sumamad u nikauzip ħaw nu sakizaja ʦaj kaujza a dada ħaw ʦanaʦanan ħaw ku nika pi[r|ɾ]uŋuʦan
S.TRANSL: 從前撒奇萊雅的生活不會要求很多事.
(Sakizaya people) did not ask for many things in the past.

FORM.notes: source note: IU 9 中的nanay 為阿美語，根據上下文語意為「就」(好讓) 。

S.FORM: saka cay kauyza u malukay mauzipay i tini i niyazu' saka kanca atu pangcah kuyni u Sakizaya nanay nanu babalaki a kawaw kuyni.
S.PHON: saka ʦaj kaujza u ma[r|ɾ]ukaj mauzipaj i tini i nijazu[ʔ|ʡ] saka kanʦa atu paŋʦaħ kujni u sakizaja nanaj nanu baba[r|ɾ]aki a kawaw kujni
S.FORM: saka cay kauyza u malukay mauzipay i tini i niyazu' saka kanca atu pangcah kuyni u Sakizaya nanay nanu babalaki a kawaw kuyni.
S.PHON: saka ʦaj kaujza u ma[r|ɾ]ukaj mauzipaj i tini i nijazu[ʔ|ʡ] saka kanʦa atu paŋʦaħ kujni u sakizaja nanaj nanu baba[r|ɾ]aki a kawaw kujni
S.TRANSL: 撒奇萊雅人在部落跟阿美族一起生活,從前就這樣.
It was in this way that Sakizaya people lived with Amis in a tribe.

S.FORM: u kakanen haw nuyni u Sakizaya hananay a tamdaw u niadupan u nibutingan tuni paluma tu canacanan.
S.PHON: u kakanən ħaw nujni u sakizaja ħananaj a tamdaw u niadupan u nibutiŋan tuni pa[r|ɾ]uma tu ʦanaʦanan
S.FORM: u kakanen haw nuyni u Sakizaya hananay a tamdaw u niadupan u nibutingan tuni paluma tu canacanan.
S.PHON: u kakanən ħaw nujni u sakizaja ħananaj a tamdaw u niadupan u nibutiŋan tuni pa[r|ɾ]uma tu ʦanaʦanan
S.TRANSL: 撒奇萊雅族人的食物是打獵來的,捕魚來的,還有種很多東西.
Sakizaya people's food came from hunting and fishing, and (they) grew up many things.

FORM.notes: source note: 根據轉注發音人(蔡宜庭)的說明，IU 17不合語法，mi-adup較好

S.FORM: saka kakaidihan nu babalaki uyni sa u nu tabuyu'ay miadupan.
S.PHON: saka kakaidiħan nu baba[r|ɾ]aki ujni sa u nu tabuju[ʔ|ʡ]aj miadupan
S.FORM: saka kakaidihan nu babalaki uyni sa u nu tabuyu'ay miadupan.
S.PHON: saka kakaidiħan nu baba[r|ɾ]aki ujni sa u nu tabuju[ʔ|ʡ]aj miadupan
S.TRANSL: 老人家最想要的去山上打獵.
What the senior citizens wanted most was going to the mountain and hunting.

S.FORM: cay ka u aadupen.
S.PHON: ʦaj ka u aadupən
S.FORM: cay ka u aadupen.
S.PHON: ʦaj ka u aadupən
S.TRANSL: 不是只有獵捕(動物).
(They) did not simply hunt.

S.FORM: Sakizaya sa uyni tu pabuy.
S.PHON: sakizaja sa ujni tu pabuj
S.FORM: Sakizaya sa uyni tu pabuy.
S.PHON: sakizaja sa ujni tu pabuj
S.TRANSL: 撒奇萊雅人獵捕豬隻.
Sakizaya people hunt pigs.

S.FORM: mibihkac anu uyni tu u mabahelay.
S.PHON: mibiħkaʦ anu ujni tu u mabaħə[r|ɾ]aj
S.FORM: mibihkac anu uyni tu u mabahelay.
S.PHON: mibiħkaʦ anu ujni tu u mabaħə[r|ɾ]aj
S.TRANSL: 會射會飛的東西.
(They) would shoot anything that would fly.

S.FORM: saka pana'en.
S.PHON: saka pana[ʔ|ʡ]ən
S.FORM: saka pana'en.
S.PHON: saka pana[ʔ|ʡ]ən
S.TRANSL: 於是就被打到.
Then (it) would be shot.

S.FORM: anu uyni tu muculilay i tini i sasa amin tu canacanan saka uyza mamin u kelin haw u sapibihkac.
S.PHON: anu ujni tu muʦu[r|ɾ]i[r|ɾ]aj i tini i sasa amin tu ʦanaʦanan saka ujza mamin u kə[r|ɾ]in ħaw u sapibiħkaʦ
S.FORM: anu uyni tu muculilay i tini i sasa amin tu canacanan saka uyza mamin u kelin haw u sapibihkac.
S.PHON: anu ujni tu muʦu[r|ɾ]i[r|ɾ]aj i tini i sasa amin tu ʦanaʦanan saka ujza mamin u kə[r|ɾ]in ħaw u sapibiħkaʦ
S.TRANSL: 用捕獸器與弓箭射在地上走的所有動物.
(They) used traps and arrows to shoot all (animals) which walked on the ground.

FORM.notes: source note: sabak稻穀、belac食用米、panay糯米、tunuz 用糯米作成的麻糬。 | source note: anu...tu 表示「如果...的話」

S.FORM: tatenga' anu tayza henay i buyu' kanca yadah haw kuyni kunuyan tu belac anu u silaw tu canacanantu.
S.PHON: tatəŋa[ʔ|ʡ] anu tajza ħənaj i buju[ʔ|ʡ] kanʦa jadaħ ħaw kujni kunujan tu bə[r|ɾ]aʦ anu u si[r|ɾ]aw tu ʦanaʦanantu
S.FORM: tatenga' anu tayza henay i buyu' kanca yadah haw kuyni kunuyan tu belac anu u silaw tu canacanantu.
S.PHON: tatəŋa[ʔ|ʡ] anu tajza ħənaj i buju[ʔ|ʡ] kanʦa jadaħ ħaw kujni kunujan tu bə[r|ɾ]aʦ anu u si[r|ɾ]aw tu ʦanaʦanantu
S.TRANSL: 只要去山上就會揹著很多米、醃豬肉還有其他的.
Whenever (they) went to the mountain, (they) would carry rice, pickled pork and others.

FORM.notes: source note: dabek在撒奇萊雅語中的意思為非住家(luma’)的建築物，可以指集會所、工寮、雞舍等。

S.FORM: tya amisadabek i buyu'.
S.PHON: tja amisadabək i buju[ʔ|ʡ]
S.FORM: tya amisadabek i buyu'.
S.PHON: tja amisadabək i buju[ʔ|ʡ]
S.TRANSL: 在山上蓋工寮.
(They) built up lodgings in the mountains.

S.FORM: tya alahican a matenes.
S.PHON: tja a[r|ɾ]aħiʦan a matənəs
S.FORM: tya alahican a matenes.
S.PHON: tja a[r|ɾ]aħiʦan a matənəs
S.TRANSL: 有時會待很久.
Sometimes (they) would stay for a long time.

FORM.notes: source note: IU 37中的lipay為中文借字，漢字寫成禮拜

S.FORM: cacay a lipay ku piadup i tini i buyu'.
S.PHON: ʦaʦaj a [r|ɾ]ipaj ku piadup i tini i buju[ʔ|ʡ]
S.FORM: cacay a lipay ku piadup i tini i buyu'.
S.PHON: ʦaʦaj a [r|ɾ]ipaj ku piadup i tini i buju[ʔ|ʡ]
S.TRANSL: 在山上打獵一星期.
(They) stayed in the mountain for one week.

S.FORM: saka anu maala ku nu pabuy tabakiay kanca i tinitu i buyu' mipacuk.
S.PHON: saka anu maa[r|ɾ]a ku nu pabuj tabakiaj kanʦa i tinitu i buju[ʔ|ʡ] mipaʦuk
S.FORM: saka anu maala ku nu pabuy tabakiay kanca i tinitu i buyu' mipacuk.
S.PHON: saka anu maa[r|ɾ]a ku nu pabuj tabakiaj kanʦa i tinitu i buju[ʔ|ʡ] mipaʦuk
S.TRANSL: 如果抓到大隻豬,一定在山上就殺好了.
If (they) caught a big pig, (they) definitely killed (it).

S.FORM: anu huwad han pataluma' sa mabadad kuyni u zazan ku niyazu' aca.
S.PHON: anu ħuwad ħan pata[r|ɾ]uma[ʔ|ʡ] sa mabadad kujni u zazan ku nijazu[ʔ|ʡ] aʦa
S.FORM: anu huwad han pataluma' sa mabadad kuyni u zazan ku niyazu' aca.
S.PHON: anu ħuwad ħan pata[r|ɾ]uma[ʔ|ʡ] sa mabadad kujni u zazan ku nijazu[ʔ|ʡ] aʦa
S.TRANSL: 如果抬回家,路途遙遠.
If (they) carried it home, it was too far.

S.FORM: a cay kakapah.
S.PHON: a ʦaj kakapaħ
S.FORM: a cay kakapah.
S.PHON: a ʦaj kakapaħ
S.TRANSL: 這樣不好.
It was not good.

S.FORM: sa cay kayadah sa kuyni u baluzu' saka.
S.PHON: sa ʦaj kajadaħ sa kujni u ba[r|ɾ]uzu[ʔ|ʡ] saka
S.FORM: sa cay kayadah sa kuyni u baluzu' saka.
S.PHON: sa ʦaj kajadaħ sa kujni u ba[r|ɾ]uzu[ʔ|ʡ] saka
S.TRANSL: 心想獵物也不多.
(They) thought that there were not many animals.

FORM.notes: source note: IU 50 與51中的mamin意思為全部。

S.FORM: i tinitu i buyu' miidid ididen ma min haw ku niadupan tya taluma' satu haw sa.
S.PHON: i tinitu i buju[ʔ|ʡ] miidid ididən ma min ħaw ku niadupan tja ta[r|ɾ]uma[ʔ|ʡ] satu ħaw sa
S.FORM: i tinitu i buyu' miidid ididen ma min haw ku niadupan tya taluma' satu haw sa.
S.PHON: i tinitu i buju[ʔ|ʡ] miidid ididən ma min ħaw ku niadupan tja ta[r|ɾ]uma[ʔ|ʡ] satu ħaw sa
S.TRANSL: 把獵物都烤了才回家.
(They) roasted the animals and then went home.

S.FORM: tu haw u bangsisay amin haw ku pataluma'ay.
S.PHON: tu ħaw u baŋsisaj amin ħaw ku pata[r|ɾ]uma[ʔ|ʡ]aj
S.FORM: tu haw u bangsisay amin haw ku pataluma'ay.
S.PHON: tu ħaw u baŋsisaj amin ħaw ku pata[r|ɾ]uma[ʔ|ʡ]aj
S.TRANSL: 拿回家的都很香.
What (they) brought home smelled good.

S.FORM: saka mahiza haw ku nikauzip babalaki.
S.PHON: saka maħiza ħaw ku nikauzip baba[r|ɾ]aki
S.FORM: saka mahiza haw ku nikauzip babalaki.
S.PHON: saka maħiza ħaw ku nikauzip baba[r|ɾ]aki
S.TRANSL: 老人家的生活就是這樣.
The senior citizens' lives were in that way.

S.FORM: saka wawa satu haw saka cay kapicudad kuyni u wawa i tawya.
S.PHON: saka wawa satu ħaw saka ʦaj kapiʦudad kujni u wawa i tawja
S.FORM: saka wawa satu haw saka cay kapicudad kuyni u wawa i tawya.
S.PHON: saka wawa satu ħaw saka ʦaj kapiʦudad kujni u wawa i tawja
S.TRANSL: 那時候小孩子都不讀書.
The children at that time did not study.

FORM.notes: source note: IU 63 中的masasu- 有「相互」的意思。

S.FORM: cay kahiza yu mahini ku nikapicudad a ma masasudemedemec.
S.PHON: ʦaj kaħiza ju maħini ku nikapiʦudad a ma masasudəmədəməʦ
S.FORM: cay kahiza yu mahini ku nikapicudad a ma masasudemedemec.
S.PHON: ʦaj kaħiza ju maħini ku nikapiʦudad a ma masasudəmədəməʦ
S.TRANSL: 不像現在要讀書,互相競爭.
Unlike nowadays, (children) will study and compete.

S.FORM: saka ca'ay sapicudad saka.
S.PHON: saka ʦa[ʔ|ʡ]aj sapiʦudad saka
S.FORM: saka ca'ay sapicudad saka.
S.PHON: saka ʦa[ʔ|ʡ]aj sapiʦudad saka
S.TRANSL: 所以不讀書.
(They) did not study.

S.FORM: kina cacay tayni i buyu' mikilul tuynian u babalaki.
S.PHON: kina ʦaʦaj tajni i buju[ʔ|ʡ] miki[r|ɾ]u[r|ɾ] tujnian u baba[r|ɾ]aki
S.FORM: kina cacay tayni i buyu' mikilul tuynian u babalaki.
S.PHON: kina ʦaʦaj tajni i buju[ʔ|ʡ] miki[r|ɾ]u[r|ɾ] tujnian u baba[r|ɾ]aki
S.TRANSL: 跟著老人家去山上一次.
(They) would follow the senior citizens to go to the mountain.

S.FORM: saka limulakay isaw ku nikaubaluzu' i tini i buyu'.
S.PHON: saka [r|ɾ]imu[r|ɾ]akaj isaw ku nikauba[r|ɾ]uzu[ʔ|ʡ] i tini i buju[ʔ|ʡ]
S.FORM: saka limulakay isaw ku nikaubaluzu' i tini i buyu'.
S.PHON: saka [r|ɾ]imu[r|ɾ]akaj isaw ku nikauba[r|ɾ]uzu[ʔ|ʡ] i tini i buju[ʔ|ʡ]
S.TRANSL: 在山上心裡很高興.
(They) were happy in the mountain.

S.FORM: haw amikilul tu babalaki a minanam haw a hicaen ku nipiwait tuyni u iduc hican a mibihkac hican ku pipana'.
S.PHON: ħaw amiki[r|ɾ]u[r|ɾ] tu baba[r|ɾ]aki a minanam ħaw a ħiʦaən ku nipiwait tujni u iduʦ ħiʦan a mibiħkaʦ ħiʦan ku pipana[ʔ|ʡ]
S.FORM: haw amikilul tu babalaki a minanam haw a hicaen ku nipiwait tuyni u iduc hican a mibihkac hican ku pipana'.
S.PHON: ħaw amiki[r|ɾ]u[r|ɾ] tu baba[r|ɾ]aki a minanam ħaw a ħiʦaən ku nipiwait tujni u iduʦ ħiʦan a mibiħkaʦ ħiʦan ku pipana[ʔ|ʡ]
S.TRANSL: (小孩)跟著老人家練習如何丟、如何射箭、如何打彈弓.
(Children) followed the senior citizens to practice how to throw, shoot and play slingshot.

S.FORM: mimelaw kuyni u wawa haw tuyni u babalaki.
S.PHON: mimə[r|ɾ]aw kujni u wawa ħaw tujni u baba[r|ɾ]aki
S.FORM: mimelaw kuyni u wawa haw tuyni u babalaki.
S.PHON: mimə[r|ɾ]aw kujni u wawa ħaw tujni u baba[r|ɾ]aki
S.TRANSL: 小孩子會一直看著老人家.
Children would be watching the senior citizens.

S.FORM: kabalakiantu caytu pakaculil kuheni sa.
S.PHON: kaba[r|ɾ]akiantu ʦajtu pakaʦu[r|ɾ]i[r|ɾ] kuħəni sa
S.FORM: kabalakiantu caytu pakaculil kuheni sa.
S.PHON: kaba[r|ɾ]akiantu ʦajtu pakaʦu[r|ɾ]i[r|ɾ] kuħəni sa
S.TRANSL: 他們老了走不動.
They were old and could not walk.

FORM.notes: source note: IU 80中的kuday為日語借字，漢字寫成交替(ko:tai)

S.FORM: uyni tu u wawa ku mamikuday.
S.PHON: ujni tu u wawa ku mamikudaj
S.FORM: uyni tu u wawa ku mamikuday.
S.PHON: ujni tu u wawa ku mamikudaj
S.TRANSL: 小孩子替代他們.
The children substituted for them.

S.FORM: anu balakitu saka mahizaay ku nika piadup sananay.
S.PHON: anu ba[r|ɾ]akitu saka maħizaaj ku nika piadup sananaj
S.FORM: anu balakitu saka mahizaay ku nika piadup sananay.
S.PHON: anu ba[r|ɾ]akitu saka maħizaaj ku nika piadup sananaj
S.TRANSL: 等(他們)長大之後才會打獵.
(They) would hunt after they grew up.

FORM.notes: source note: Amis a binacadan (阿美族原住民)。 | source note: IU 87 與88中的 mamin意思為全部。

S.FORM: cay kau mita tada Sakizaya anu uyni tu u Amis anu uyni tu u canacanan a a binacadan a tamdaw tabuyu' ma min.
S.PHON: ʦaj kau mita tada sakizaja anu ujni tu u amis anu ujni tu u ʦanaʦanan a a binaʦadan a tamdaw tabuju[ʔ|ʡ] ma min
S.FORM: cay kau mita tada Sakizaya anu uyni tu u Amis anu uyni tu u canacanan a a binacadan a tamdaw tabuyu' ma min.
S.PHON: ʦaj kau mita tada sakizaja anu ujni tu u amis anu ujni tu u ʦanaʦanan a a binaʦadan a tamdaw tabuju[ʔ|ʡ] ma min
S.TRANSL: 不是只有我們撒奇萊雅人,還有阿美族人以及其他的原住民都會到山上.
Not only Sakizaya people but also Amis and other indigenous people would go to the mountain.

FORM.notes: source note: IU 89中的nawhani 南勢阿美語；撒奇萊雅語則為 zayhansa

S.FORM: nawhani mamin nima ku aadupen i tini i buyu'.
S.PHON: nawħani mamin nima ku aadupən i tini i buju[ʔ|ʡ]
S.FORM: nawhani mamin nima ku aadupen i tini i buyu'.
S.PHON: nawħani mamin nima ku aadupən i tini i buju[ʔ|ʡ]
S.TRANSL: 山上有很多獵物.
There were many prey in the mountain.

FORM.notes: source note: IU91的tu作為主題標記。

S.FORM: nanika u zuma tu ku nikauzip nu mita i mahini saka.
S.PHON: nanika u zuma tu ku nikauzip nu mita i maħini saka
S.FORM: nanika u zuma tu ku nikauzip nu mita i mahini saka.
S.PHON: nanika u zuma tu ku nikauzip nu mita i maħini saka
S.TRANSL: 現在我們的生活已經改變了.
Now our lives have changed.

S.FORM: caytu papiadup.
S.PHON: ʦajtu papiadup
S.FORM: caytu papiadup.
S.PHON: ʦajtu papiadup
S.TRANSL: 不可以打獵.
(We) could not hunt.

S.FORM: mahizaay saka tatenga' yadahtu ku nika niadupan niididan saka taluma'tu.
S.PHON: maħizaaj saka tatəŋa[ʔ|ʡ] jadaħtu ku nika niadupan niididan saka ta[r|ɾ]uma[ʔ|ʡ]tu
S.FORM: mahizaay saka tatenga' yadahtu ku nika niadupan niididan saka taluma'tu.
S.PHON: maħizaaj saka tatəŋa[ʔ|ʡ] jadaħtu ku nika niadupan niididan saka ta[r|ɾ]uma[ʔ|ʡ]tu
S.TRANSL: 打到的獵物很多,也烤完了,要帶回家了.
(They) hunt many animals, roasted and took home.

S.FORM: malikeluntu haw nai buyu'.
S.PHON: ma[r|ɾ]ikə[r|ɾ]untu ħaw nai buju[ʔ|ʡ]
S.FORM: malikeluntu haw nai buyu'.
S.PHON: ma[r|ɾ]ikə[r|ɾ]untu ħaw nai buju[ʔ|ʡ]
S.TRANSL: 從山上下來.
(They) came down from the mountain.

FORM.notes: source note: IU 101與102中的tabaki意思為「大的」。

S.FORM: a taluma' sa kanca mudadiw i tini i zazan taba ki mamin kuyni u dadiw.
S.PHON: a ta[r|ɾ]uma[ʔ|ʡ] sa kanʦa mudadiw i tini i zazan taba ki mamin kujni u dadiw
S.FORM: a taluma' sa kanca mudadiw i tini i zazan taba ki mamin kuyni u dadiw.
S.PHON: a ta[r|ɾ]uma[ʔ|ʡ] sa kanʦa mudadiw i tini i zazan taba ki mamin kujni u dadiw
S.TRANSL: 在回家的路上一定會大聲唱歌.
On the way home, (they) would sing aloud.

S.FORM: babalaki mudadiw.
S.PHON: baba[r|ɾ]aki mudadiw
S.FORM: babalaki mudadiw.
S.PHON: baba[r|ɾ]aki mudadiw
S.TRANSL: 老人也唱.
The senior citizens sang songs.

S.FORM: saka makatengil ku i tiniay i niyazu'ay a luma'.
S.PHON: saka makatəŋi[r|ɾ] ku i tiniaj i nijazu[ʔ|ʡ]aj a [r|ɾ]uma[ʔ|ʡ]
S.FORM: saka makatengil ku i tiniay i niyazu'ay a luma'.
S.PHON: saka makatəŋi[r|ɾ] ku i tiniaj i nijazu[ʔ|ʡ]aj a [r|ɾ]uma[ʔ|ʡ]
S.TRANSL: 所以,要讓部落的人家聽到.
So, the people in this tribe could hear it.

S.FORM: a izawtu haw ku miadupay taluma'tu.
S.PHON: a izawtu ħaw ku miadupaj ta[r|ɾ]uma[ʔ|ʡ]tu
S.FORM: a izawtu haw ku miadupay taluma'tu.
S.PHON: a izawtu ħaw ku miadupaj ta[r|ɾ]uma[ʔ|ʡ]tu
S.TRANSL: 打獵的人回來了.
The hunters came back.

FORM.notes: source note: IU 107 與108中的tada cay haw 意思為「無法壓抑之情感」。

S.FORM: cay kuheni saka tada ca haw ka limulak nu balucu' a maduba' a milikeluh.
S.PHON: ʦaj kuħəni saka tada ʦa ħaw ka [r|ɾ]imu[r|ɾ]ak nu ba[r|ɾ]uʦu[ʔ|ʡ] a maduba[ʔ|ʡ] a mi[r|ɾ]ikə[r|ɾ]uħ
